cues.title: 验证燃烧产物
cues.caption: 水滴与石灰水：两份不同证据。
cues.captionEn: Droplets and limewater provide different evidence.
cues.zh: 综合活动先从乙醇开始。燃烧后的干燥收集器出现水滴，另一份产物检验使澄清石灰水浑浊。两项证据分别对应水和二氧化碳。教材要求设计验证方案，画面展示一种教学对照；不能只看蓝色火焰就宣称已经确认了所有燃烧产物。
cues.en: The combined activity starts with ethanol. Water droplets appear in a dry collector after combustion, while a separate limewater test becomes cloudy. These support water and carbon dioxide formation. The textbook asks learners to design the tests; this is one teaching example. A blue flame alone does not identify all combustion products.

cues.title: 重访催化氧化
cues.caption: 同一铜丝循环，产物逐渐累积。
cues.captionEn: The same copper cycles as product accumulates.
cues.zh: 接着追踪同一根铜丝。空气中受热形成的黑色氧化铜，在接触乙醇后恢复铜色；往返几次，产物逐渐积累。这个循环解释了综合活动为何重复操作。铜总量保持不变，净反应消耗乙醇和氧气。这里生成的是醛类产物乙醛，与刚才的完全燃烧不同。
cues.en: Next, follow the same copper coil. Black oxide forms during heating in air, then copper colour returns on contact with ethanol. Repetition accumulates product and explains the repeated observation in the activity. Total copper is conserved while ethanol and oxygen are net reactants. This oxidation produces acetaldehyde, an aldehyde, unlike the previous complete combustion.

cues.title: 设计酸性证据
cues.caption: 颜色与气体共同支持酸性。
cues.captionEn: Colour and gas provide evidence of acidity.
cues.zh: 综合活动还要求设计乙酸的性质实验。这里选石蕊颜色与碳酸盐反应作为两种证据：酸性环境使石蕊呈红色，乙酸与碳酸盐反应放出二氧化碳。后者联系乙酸与碳酸的酸性比较。它也为下一步解释接收液的作用作铺垫：碳酸钠可以把混入的乙酸转为乙酸盐。
cues.en: The activity also asks for evidence of ethanoic acid properties. Here, litmus turns red and carbonate releases carbon dioxide. These observations support acidity and connect to comparing ethanoic acid with carbonic acid. The carbonate reaction will matter again in the receiver: it converts carried-over ethanoic acid into an acetate salt.

cues.title: 追踪酯中的氧
cues.caption: 标记氧会进入酯，还是水？
cues.captionEn: Will the labelled oxygen enter ester or water?
cues.zh: 接收液出现酯较多的上层，但分层不能告诉我们哪根键重组。现在给乙醇的氧做十八氧标记：它会进入酯，还是水？教材的示踪结论是，标记氧留在酯中。沿着同一个氧看，乙醇的碳氧键保留。按净反应记账，酸的羟基与醇羟基的氢计入水，其余部分形成酯的连接。这是原子去向的对照，不是一步碰撞的机理。酸参与催化并再生，反应仍然可逆。接下来，再看产物怎样被收集。
cues.en: An ester-rich upper layer appears, but a layer cannot tell us which bonds changed. Label the oxygen in ethanol with oxygen eighteen. Will it enter the ester or the water? The textbook tracing result places it in the ester. Follow that same oxygen: its bond to the ethyl group stays. In the net account, the acid hydroxyl and the alcohol hydroxyl hydrogen form water; the remaining groups make the ester connection. This tracks atom destinations, not a one-step collision mechanism. Acid participates and regenerates, and the reaction remains reversible. Next, follow product collection.

cues.title: 跟随混合蒸气
cues.caption: 反应生成，不等于已经收集。
cues.captionEn: Ester formed is not ester collected.
cues.zh: 导管中移动的不同颜色代表不同组分，不是真实分子的颜色。收集到的液体不只是目标酯，还可能带来乙醇、乙酸和水。模型将反应与转移分别记账，所以生成的酯不等于已经收集到的酯。加热和催化剂改变过程速度，移走产物也能影响可逆反应的推进。
cues.en: Different dot colours represent components, not the real colours of molecules. Collected material can include ethanol, ethanoic acid and water alongside the target ester. The model separately accounts for reaction and transfer, so ester formed is not the same as ester collected. Heating and catalysis affect speed; product removal can also influence reversible reaction progress.

cues.title: 区分上下两层
cues.caption: 分层帮助分离，不代表纯品。
cues.captionEn: Layers help separation; neither is pure.
cues.zh: 接收液各有作用：碳酸盐与乙酸反应，乙醇容易进入水层，盐溶液还会降低酯的溶解。静置后，较轻、酯较多的液层出现在上方。但上层不等于纯乙酸乙酯，下层也不等于完全没有酯。画面用分层帮助判断分离方向，不用油层厚度宣称实际纯度或产率。
cues.en: The receiver has several roles. Carbonate neutralises acid; ethanol readily enters the aqueous layer; dissolved salt reduces ester solubility. On standing, the less dense ester-rich layer appears above. Neither layer is perfectly pure. The drawing shows a separation direction; layer thickness is not a measurement of product purity or yield.

cues.title: 控制介质变量
cues.caption: 同样起点，只改变介质。
cues.captionEn: Same starting amounts; change the medium.
cues.zh: 反过来看酯的水解。三支试管从相同酯量出发，在同一个水浴中比较中性、酸性和碱性条件。此处选用教学参数，展示酸或碱能够明显促进水解的一组情况。剩余酯读数和酯层变化来自同一计算，但数值不是教材实测结果。不同浓度下，酸和碱之间的快慢顺序不能一概而论。
cues.en: Now reverse the question and examine hydrolysis. Three tubes start with equal ester amounts in one water bath, comparing neutral, acid and base conditions. The selected teaching parameters illustrate accelerated hydrolysis in acid or base. The remaining-ester count and layer change share one calculation, but are not textbook measurements. Relative acid and base speeds are not universal across concentrations.

cues.title: 理解酸性水解
cues.caption: 同温同初态，更快会改变终点吗？
cues.captionEn: Same start and temperature: does faster change the endpoint?
cues.zh: 酸性条件下，乙酸乙酯与水反应生成乙酸和乙醇，两个方向都保留。酸催化剂使反应更快，并不会单凭催化剂身份改变平衡常数。水的用量与产物移出等条件可以影响组成。下方的双向流只表示反应方向仍然存在，不是测量到的分子轨迹或速率。
cues.en: In acid, ethyl ethanoate reacts with water to form ethanoic acid and ethanol, while the reverse reaction remains possible. The catalyst accelerates reaction without itself changing the equilibrium constant. Water amount or product removal can affect composition. The paired flows indicate available directions, not measured molecular trajectories or reaction rates.

cues.title: 追踪碱的消耗
cues.caption: 每水解一份酯，消耗一份OH⁻。
cues.captionEn: Each ester hydrolysed consumes one hydroxide.
cues.zh: 碱性条件要换一种记账。羧酸部分以乙酸根保留下来，每水解一份酯，就消耗一份氢氧根。这与把碱说成永远不变的催化剂不同。乙酸根在这些条件下不容易与乙醇回到原来的酯，推动反应向前。自由探索减少初始氢氧根，会看到碱不足时酯仍有剩余。
cues.en: Basic conditions require a different account. The acid-derived group remains as acetate, and each ester hydrolysed consumes one hydroxide. Base is therefore not an unchanged catalyst here. Acetate does not readily return to the ester with ethanol under these conditions, helping drive the process forward. Reducing initial hydroxide in exploration leaves ester when the base runs out.

cues.title: 单独比较温度
cues.caption: 只改温度；层消失不等于反应完全。
cues.captionEn: Change temperature alone; no layer need not mean full conversion.
cues.zh: 最后只改变温度，同样的介质、起始份数和示意时长，比较较冷与较热的体系。模型中升温使水解更快。教材探究建议比较酯层消失时间，章末活动还讨论气味变化；这里用可见的层变化替代嗅觉操作。溶解、混合与挥发也会影响实际观察，因此层看不见不能直接等同于百分之百转化。
cues.en: Finally, change only temperature while keeping medium, starting amounts and model duration fixed. Heating accelerates the model reaction. The inquiry suggests comparing layer-disappearance times, while the activity also discusses odour change; this visualization uses visible layers. Dissolution, mixing and evaporation affect real observations too, so disappearance of a layer is not proof of complete conversion.

question.zh: 酯中的氧，原来在哪个分子里？
question.en: Which molecule supplied the ester oxygen?

lead.zh: 从上层液体追到教材的同位素证据，再分清发生反应、收集与分层。
lead.en: Follow the upper layer to textbook isotope evidence, then distinguish reaction, collection and separation.

principle.zh: 乙醇中的标记氧保留在酯中，醇的碳氧连接不被切断。净反应同时保存原子与碳骨架；生成的酯还须经过转移和分层，收集液不是纯品。
principle.en: The labelled ethanol oxygen remains in the ester, retaining its bond to the ethyl group. Net bookkeeping preserves atoms and carbon groups. Product still needs transfer and separation; the collected liquid is not pure.

question.zh: 只标记乙醇的氧，按教材净对应，水中会出现这个标记吗？
question.en: If only ethanol oxygen is labelled, does that label enter water in the textbook net mapping?

explanation.zh: 不会。标记氧连接酰基碳与乙基，留在酯中。水中的氧在这组净对应里来自酸的羟基；这不是溶液中质子移动或氧交换的完整微观机理。
explanation.en: No. The label links the acyl carbon to the ethyl group and remains in the ester. In this net mapping, water oxygen comes from the acid hydroxyl. This is not a complete microscopic description of proton transfer or oxygen exchange.

question.zh: 酯中的氧，原来在哪个分子里？
question.en: Which molecule supplied the ester oxygen?

lead.zh: 先区分乙醇燃烧、铜丝氧化与乙酸酸性的证据，再追问制酯时同一个氧的去向。
lead.en: Distinguish the evidence for combustion, copper-mediated oxidation and acid properties, then track the same oxygen during ester preparation.

principle.zh: 乙醇中的标记氧保留在酯中，醇的碳氧连接不被切断。净反应同时保存原子与碳骨架；生成的酯还须经过转移和分层，收集液不是纯品。

question.zh: 水解更快，就一定水解得更多吗？
question.en: Does faster hydrolysis mean more hydrolysis in the end?

lead.zh: 保持起始量和温度，比较可逆酸性水解与消耗碱的水解；再单独改变温度。
lead.en: Hold starting amounts and temperature fixed; compare reversible acid hydrolysis with hydroxide consumption, then vary temperature separately.

principle.zh: 酸催化同时加快两个方向，不单凭催化剂身份改变同温闭系的平衡组成。碱性水解则消耗OH⁻并留下羧酸盐；它有不同的净物料账。
principle.en: Acid catalysis accelerates both directions without itself changing the equilibrium composition of the same closed system at fixed temperature. Basic hydrolysis consumes hydroxide and leaves carboxylate, so its net material account differs.

question.zh: 相同酯和水、相同温度，只增加催化作用，最终组成会改变吗？
question.en: With the same ester, water and temperature, does a purely catalytic change alter the final composition?

explanation.zh: 在这里的封闭理想对照中不会；只是更快达到同一个平衡。改变水量、移走产物或消耗OH⁻，则改变了物料条件，不能与纯催化混为一谈。
explanation.en: Not in this closed ideal comparison: the system reaches the same equilibrium sooner. Changing water, removing product or consuming hydroxide changes material conditions and is a different comparison.

question.zh: 水解更快，就一定水解得更多吗？
question.en: Does faster hydrolysis mean more hydrolysis in the end?

lead.zh: 先沿标记氧认清酯的连接和收集过程，再用水解检验可逆反应与催化的解释。
lead.en: Track labelled oxygen through ester formation and collection, then test reversibility and catalysis through hydrolysis.

scientificLimits: Net oxygen/atom correspondence is not a one-step mechanism; no specific proton relay is claimed.
Alcohol 18O destination is textbook evidence; displayed paths are constructed, not measured trajectories.
Closed catalyst comparison is isothermal, same initial amounts, no collection; chosen ideal mass-action K_ester=4, both rates multiplied together.

Preparation, bath acid/neutral branches and closed hydrolysis share K_ester=4; the bath calls the same analytic closed balance. Temperature and observation time map to one rate coordinate. Basic hydrolysis separately consumes OH-. Transport and phase splits remain declared teaching approximations, not measured yield.
